name: instagram-profile-scraper
title: Instagram Profile Scraper - Public Profile Analytics
description: Public Instagram profile analytics: followers, published bio links, optional recent-post summaries and precision-aware watchlist changes. HTTP-only at 256 MB; no login, media downloads or private profiles. Pay per saved public profile.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

profile-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each public Instagram profile successfully scraped.
